articles.title: Mr. T has his first documentary about his life but calls it “garbage” before its Netflix premiere
articles.standfirst: The production dedicated to the actor’s life is about to arrive, but he has already seen the final cut and did not hold back about what he thinks.
articles.summary: The production dedicated to the actor’s life is about to arrive, but he has already seen the final cut and did not hold back about what he thinks.
articles.body:
At 74, Mr. T is about to have a production dedicated entirely to telling his life story for the first time . The project brings together moments from his childhood, his rise in Hollywood, his most memorable roles and several stages of his career that helped turn him into one of the most recognizable figures in pop culture. However, there is one small detail that changes the story completely: he has already given his opinion on the final result .

Mr. T called the result “garbage”

The actor said he was unable to see the finished material until about a month before its premiere, which is scheduled for September 8 . When he finally watched the final cut, his reaction was immediate: he said the project upset him because he felt it left out too many aspects of his life and went as far as describing it as “garbage.”

One of the reasons behind that reaction had to do with the involvement of people close to him. Mr. T explained that his pastor was interviewed as part of the project and that the conversations lasted for two days. However, he discovered that only about 30 seconds of all that material had made it into the final version, a small amount of time that, from his perspective, did not do justice to the importance his pastor has in his life .

He also questioned the presence of his former agent

But that was not the only documentary decision that upset him. Mr. T found that someone he had, according to him, specifically asked not to be involved in the project had also appeared in it.

It was Peter Young, who was his agent and appeared to discuss some of the decisions in his career and film opportunities that, according to him, the actor turned down for financial reasons.

For Mr. T, the problem is that these kinds of stories end up taking up significant space , while other aspects of his life that he considers far more important are pushed into the background.

A career that goes beyond his bad decisions

During the 1980s, he used his popularity to share messages with children about respect, drugs, peer pressure, and personal effort. Over the years, he also worked with organizations such as Make-A-Wish and Starlight to support seriously ill children .

He has also spoken about the importance of his mother in his life. He grew up alongside his 11 siblings, and after achieving success, one of his main goals was to buy her a house . His social and spiritual practices have also been an important part of his life.

Now, all that remains is for the public to have the opportunity to learn his story and form their own opinion about the production, as well as decide whether it truly succeeds in honoring his life as he had hoped.

articles.title: How many times has Shailene Woodley been nominated for an Emmy? This happened before she won her first award
articles.standfirst: The actress once again appeared among television’s biggest stars after waiting several years for another opportunity at the awards.
articles.summary: The actress once again appeared among television’s biggest stars after waiting several years for another opportunity at the awards.
articles.body:
S hailene Woodley has just experienced one of the most important nights of her television career, but to understand what this moment means , it is necessary to go back several years. Before competing for a statuette again, the actress had already appeared in one of the Emmys’ major categories and knew firsthand what it was like to come one step short of recognition.

Woodley’s first Emmy nomination came in 2017 thanks to Big Little Lies . Her performance as Jane Chapman earned her a nomination for Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Limited Series or Movie, as part of an HBO production that brought together some of the industry’s most acclaimed actresses.

That time, the statuette went to Laura Dern, who was also part of the Big Little Lies cast. Woodley was left without the award, and several years would pass before she appeared on the list of nominees again.

Paradise put her back among the nominees

Her new opportunity arrived in 2026 with Paradise . In the second season of the series created by Dan Fogelman, Woodley played Annie Clay , a former Graceland tour guide whose journey became increasingly important to the story.

Her work in the episode “Graceland” earned her another Emmy nomination, this time in a different category: Outstanding Guest Actress in a Drama Series . It was there that her history with the awards took a different turn from what happened nearly a decade earlier.

So, how many times has Shailene Woodley been nominated for an Emmy?

In total, Shailene Woodley has received two Emmy nominations and has won one statuette, adding the achievement to a career that began when she was a child and has taken her into different areas of the entertainment industry over the years.

Woodley rose to fame with The Secret Life of the American Teenager before making the jump to film with major movies, including The Fault in Our Stars . She later returned to television with Big Little Lies and expanded her experience as an actress by making her Broadway debut in Cult of Love.

At 34, the actress continues to have a busy schedule and has several projects in the works, including Motor City, Ultra and A Beautiful Journey. She is also attached to the biographical project about Janis Joplin, in which she will portray the legendary singer.

articles.title: Dua Lipa surprises with her boldest look to celebrate Labor Day
articles.standfirst: The singer took advantage of the holiday to enjoy the beach and share several summer looks that did not go unnoticed.
articles.summary: The singer took advantage of the holiday to enjoy the beach and share several summer looks that did not go unnoticed.
articles.body:
Labor Day brought Dua Lipa a much-needed break . This Monday, September 7, the singer stepped away from her usual routine for a few hours by the sea and gave her followers a glimpse of how she spent the day.

“Everyone left the city for Labour Day... so naturally I observed the holiday too,” she wrote on Instagram, accompanying the images with a humorous caption. The phrase showed that Dua did not want to miss out on a tradition that, for many, marks the end of summer.

The singer was joined by a couple of friends, enjoying the beach and having a few drinks as she took in the relaxed holiday atmosphere.

But Dua did not stick to just one look throughout the day. The carousel also featured several of her style changes.

Bikinis and summer looks that defined her day

One of the first outfits she showed off was a black two-piece bikini, paired with a blue baseball cap that gave the look a much more casual feel .

She later appeared in a neon yellow T-shirt with a star on the front, revealing the bikini underneath. In another photo, she opted for a green dress with pink details and a touch of lace at the neckline, while wearing her hair up.

The outfit changes kept the post firmly in summer mode, but there was still one photo that strayed far from the beachy vibe and ultimately became the standout image of the carousel.

Dua Lipa's boldest look that stole the spotlight

Among the images in her post, Dua Lipa appeared reclining, with her hair down and a choice that immediately turned up the heat: a fitted, sheer black slip dress worn over matching black lingerie .

But there was something else about the scene. Dua did not need a red carpet or a carefully staged pose to create that effect. The image was simply part of her Labor Day recap, an apparently casual snapshot that ended up being one of the most daring photos in the entire post .

And it was precisely that mix of naturalness and sensuality that made the look impossible to overlook.

Dua Lipa is still away from the stage for now

The break also comes at an interesting point in the singer's career. Dua Lipa does not currently have an active tour or any concerts scheduled in the near future.

Her Radical Optimism Tour officially wrapped up at the end of December 2025 after traveling to different cities, including several stops in Latin America such as Santiago and Mexico City.

For now, there are also no official dates announced for a new tour in 2027, leaving her fans watching closely for any sign of what her next professional move might be.

articles.title: Morgan Freeman, 89, admits there is one actor whose career he wishes he had
articles.standfirst: After decades in Hollywood and some of the most memorable roles of his generation, Freeman still looks at one actor
articles.summary: After decades in Hollywood and some of the most memorable roles of his generation, Freeman still looks at one actor
articles.body:
Morgan Freeman has spent decades building the kind of career most actors could only dream about. He has an Oscar, some of the most recognizable movies in Hollywood history and, at 89, he is still working. But there is one actor whose career makes him think about the roles he never got to play.

That actor is Denzel Washington. When Freeman was asked whether there was still a type of role he wished he could play, his answer quickly turned to Washington. “Who I envy is Denzel,” Freeman told Rolling Stone . “Denzel Washington is doing what I wanted to do.”

Morgan Freeman wanted the action roles Denzel Washington got

The reason is surprisingly simple. Freeman always wanted to do more action movies. His film career didn't really take off until he was around 50, after spending roughly 20 years working on Broadway, and by then his path in Hollywood had started taking him in a different direction.

“I took the jobs that were offered and I thought I was doing well, and I was,” Freeman explained. “But not those action flicks.” At his age now, he also accepts that physically demanding action roles are no longer realistic for him.

It is a surprising admission from an actor whose résumé includes The Shawshank Redemption, Se7en, Million Dollar Baby and The Dark Knight trilogy . Freeman won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for Million Dollar Baby and became one of the most recognizable actors and voices in Hollywood.

Freeman and Washington's careers have even crossed before. They appeared together in Glory in 1989 , the movie that earned Washington his first Academy Award. From there, Washington went on to combine dramatic roles with the kind of action movies Freeman says he always wanted to make.

Freeman doesn't sound unhappy with the career he got. He is still working at 89 and has said he has no plans to retire. But after all those movies, awards and decades in Hollywood, he can still look at another actor's career and admit there was something he wanted that he never quite got to do.

articles.title: Stephen King, writer: "You only need one thing: a door you can close. It's a way of telling the world you mean business"
articles.standfirst: "The search for purpose can help us confront the feeling of being lost
articles.summary: "The search for purpose can help us confront the feeling of being lost
articles.body:
S tephen King , a master of horror, has traced in his work "On Writing" an intimate connection between the search for personal authenticity and the pressure of the contemporary environment. His reflection on writing as a sacred space, where closing the door symbolizes commitment to oneself, resonates in a hyperconnected world that encourages social comparison and individualism. In a context where the fear of making mistakes intensifies, many feel trapped between the search for purpose and anxiety about the future .'

This dilemma is especially relevant today , as the pace of daily life and the excess of stimuli can make us feel disconnected from ourselves. King's call to find value in imperfection invites those who struggle for external validation to refocus their energy on authenticity and self-care, promoting an acceptance of individuality in a world that rewards conformity.

To understand the feeling that our life has no direction, Stephen King's thinking offers an especially interesting perspective . His reflection on the search for purpose suggests that in our personal narrative, finding meaning behind experiences, even the darkest ones, can guide us toward a clearer and more authentic path.

Your writing space can be modest; in fact, it only needs one thing: a door you can close. The closed door is a way of telling the world and yourself that you mean business.

The power of writing and personal space according to Stephen King

Stephen King is an American author recognized for his mastery of the horror and fiction genres, whose works have sold millions of copies worldwide. King has become an authoritative figure in the literary world thanks to bestsellers such as "The Shining" and "Misery." His focus on building deeply terrifying characters and settings has impacted readers and writers alike, making him a benchmark of contemporary narrative. Throughout his career, he has shared reflections on the writing process and the discipline needed to cultivate a space conducive to creativity.

Stephen King's thinking is deeply rooted in experience and in the commitment required to be a successful writer. His famous work "On Writing" offers valuable lessons about the creative process, hard work, and authenticity . Like King, other authors such as Ray Bradbury and Ernest Hemingway have also emphasized the importance of having an appropriate space for writing, one that translates into an intimate connection with the process. The idea of "the closed door" that King mentions suggests that the act of writing requires privacy and determination, a principle that resonates with the search for one's own voice in the vast literary world.

articles.title: Brendan Fraser, actor: "I don't believe that wishing works. I think we get the things we work for"
articles.standfirst: Brendan Fraser's words about hard work have taken on a deeper meaning over the course of his career
articles.summary: Brendan Fraser's words about hard work have taken on a deeper meaning over the course of his career
articles.body:
B rendan Fraser has offered a simple philosophy about achieving goals, rejecting the idea that simply hoping for something is enough to make it happen.

The actor said: "I don't believe that wishing works. I think we get the things we work for." The quote has continued to circulate as an example of Fraser's approach to ambition, effort and personal growth.

Rather than presenting success as something that arrives through luck or desire alone, the sentiment places responsibility on the individual.

Wanting a particular outcome can be the starting point, but Fraser's words suggest that meaningful results require action and sustained effort. That message is particularly interesting when viewed alongside Fraser's own career.

The actor became one of Hollywood's most recognizable stars during the 1990s and early 2000s, appearing in films including Encino Man, George of the Jungle and The Mummy.

His work in The Mummy franchise turned him into an international box-office star, while his performances in films such as Gods and Monsters demonstrated that he could move between broad commercial entertainment and more serious material.

His career subsequently entered a much quieter period. Fraser stepped back from the center of Hollywood attention while dealing with personal and professional difficulties.

In later interviews, he discussed the physical toll of performing demanding action roles, including multiple surgeries.

The actor's eventual return made his quote about working for what you want particularly striking.

Fraser's career comeback put his philosophy to the test

Fraser's major resurgence began to take shape in the early 2020s. He appeared in Steven Soderbergh's No Sudden Move before landing the leading role in Darren Aronofsky 's The Whale. The 2022 film became the defining project of his comeback.

Fraser played Charlie , an isolated English teacher attempting to reconnect with his teenage daughter. The performance received widespread critical acclaim, and his appearance at the Venice Film Festival produced an emotional response when the movie received a six-minute standing ovation.

The following year, Fraser reached the biggest individual milestone of his career.

At the 95th Academy Awards in March 2023, he won the Oscar for Best Actor for The Whale. It was his first Academy Award and the culmination of a comeback that had taken years to develop.

During his acceptance speech, Fraser reflected on how difficult his journey had been, saying that he had entered the entertainment business three decades earlier and that success had not come easily to him.

That history gives his observation about wishing versus working a particularly fitting context. Fraser's return was not the result of simply waiting for Hollywood to remember him.

It involved taking on demanding roles, rebuilding his career and delivering performances that eventually earned major industry recognition.

His work has continued since his Oscar win. Fraser recently portrayed General Dwight D. Eisenhower in Pressure, a World War II drama about the crucial weather decision surrounding the D-Day invasion.

At the film's European premiere in London in September 2026, he discussed the importance of listening to science and making careful decisions under pressure.

He is also preparing to return to one of the roles that originally made him a household name, with a fourth Mummy film in development and Fraser returning as Rick O'Connell .

The continued interest in Fraser's words therefore comes from more than their motivational quality. His career provides a real-world example of the distinction he makes between wishing for something and working toward it.

The quote does not promise that effort will always produce the desired result. Instead, it emphasizes the part of success that remains within an individual's control: showing up, putting in the work and continuing to pursue an objective even when the path becomes considerably more difficult than expected.

For an actor whose career has already included blockbuster fame, professional setbacks, an extended absence from the Hollywood spotlight and an Oscar-winning comeback, Fraser's philosophy carries considerable weight.

His message is ultimately straightforward: wanting something may inspire the journey, but it is the work that moves it forward.

articles.title: Hayden Panettiere's mother denies boyfriend Brian Hickerson's account of her death and accuses him of stealing actress' belongings
articles.standfirst: New questions emerge over Panettiere’s final hours as her mom speaks out
articles.summary: New questions emerge over Panettiere’s final hours as her mom speaks out
articles.body:
Hayden Panettiere ’s mother Lesley Vogel has raised new questions about the account given after her daughter’s death, while stressing that she wants answers as investigators continue to examine what happened.

Vogel is publicly challenging parts of the timeline surrounding the actress’ death, saying she doesn't believe Brian Hickerson ’s reported version of events fully makes sense, as per RadarOnline.com.

Panettiere died on August 16 at age 36 after being found unresponsive at an Airbnb in Greenville, South Carolina, where she had reportedly been staying with Hickerson . Authorities have said there were no signs of foul play, and toxicology results remain pending.

According to Vogel , Hickerson told police that Panettiere was doing her makeup when he left the property around 10 a.m. and that he did not speak with her after returning.

Vogel said Hickerson also told investigators he went to sleep, woke when his brother Zach knocked at the door and then found Panettiere unresponsive. That account has left her with questions.

“I don’t know how you can take a nap near someone who’s dying and not realize something’s wrong,” Vogel said.

What happened before emergency crews arrived?

Vogel has also focused on reports that Narcan was administered to Panettiere before emergency responders arrived.

“When the EMTs came, it was for cardiac arrest,” Vogel said. “People in cardiac arrest aren’t just lying still. They make noise.”

She went further, alleging that she believes Hickerson already knew Panettiere “was deceased,” then “called his brother” and “built this story.”

Those claims are Vogel ’s own suspicions and have not been established by law enforcement.

Hickerson ’s legal team has declined to respond directly to the accusations, referring instead to an earlier statement.

“Hayden’s death remains under investigation and it is important to allow that investigation to proceed,” an attorney said. “As has been publicly reported, police confirmed there were no signs of foul play.”

Vogel has also alleged that Hickerson pawned some of Panettiere’s belongings, including a vintage guitar, and kept other items in a storage unit. Those claims haven't been independently verified.

Past struggles remain part of investigation

Panettiere had spoken publicly in the past about addiction and sobriety, and people who worked with her have since described concern over her well-being.

Griff Furst , who directed her in the 2025 thriller A Breed Apart, said Panettiere ’s team had discussed staging an intervention during production.

articles.title: "$40 million for my silence": Elon Musk's ex defies the magnate in her new documentary
articles.standfirst: Ashley St. Clair, mother of one of Musk's children, says she rejected a confidentiality agreement that could have reached that amount in order to speak about her relationship with the businessman in Alex Gibney's film, premiered in Venice.
articles.summary: Ashley St. Clair, mother of one of Musk's children, says she rejected a confidentiality agreement that could have reached that amount in order to speak about her relationship with the businessman in Alex Gibney's film, premiered in Venice.
articles.body:
Ashley claims she turned down a confidentiality offer that could have reached $40 million in exchange for not speaking publicly about her relationship with the tycoon.

The former conservative influencer and mother of one of Elon Musk 's fourteen children decided to take part in the documentary because she prefers to tell her version of events rather than accept an agreement that, she says, sought to silence her account.

The multimillion-dollar offer St. Clair turned down

' Ashley St. Clair arrived at the Venice Festival with a story that sums up many of the contradictions Alex Gibney tries to explore in "Musk," the nearly four-hour documentary devoted to the richest man in the world: she claims she rejected a confidentiality proposal that could have reached 40 million dollars in exchange for not speaking publicly about her relationship with the magnate.'

The figure comes from St. Clair herself and not from a publicly released document that would allow all the terms of the alleged agreement to be independently verified. U.S. media have reported that, according to her version, the proposal initially included $15 million and monthly payments for 20 years.

In an interview before the premiere, Ashley spoke about why she decided to take part in the film after turning down the offer “I think my children need to know that there are things more important than money,” she explained in justifying her decision to participate in the film.

A personal story within a portrait of power

'Ashley, one of the documentary's most prominent testimonies, went on to say: "When you're offered something like that, it really makes you reflect on what your speech means and how valuable it is, and why they want to offer me this amount of money so that I don't speak". '

St. Clair explained that her decision was related to the example she wants to set for her children and to her refusal to put money ahead of what she considers the truth: "material comfort should never be put before telling the truth," and added that "Musk's most complicated relationship is with the truth."

"Musk", is a 232-minute film that premiered on September 8 out of competition at the Venice Film Festival and reconstructs the business, political, and personal rise of the man who went from being a tech entrepreneur to becoming one of the figures with the greatest capacity to influence governments, markets, social media, and technology.

The film, directed by Academy Award-winning documentary filmmaker Alex Gibney, focuses on the influence of the 55-year-old South African billionaire on American politics.

The director presents the businessman as someone whose main skill would not be solely engineering or innovation, but the ability to sell a vision of the future and convince others to bet on it.

Gibney also draws a parallel between Musk and Elizabeth Holmes , especially because of their ability to convince investors and the public to bet on a particular vision. The director, however, points out a difference: in his view, Musk’s companies have indeed produced real technological advances, especially SpaceX and Tesla.

“A legion of children before the civil war”

Among the most striking statements in the claim, St. Clair spoke about her relationship with the magnate and the vision Musk has for the future.

'Among one of the most influential statements is the one that Elon would seek to have a "legion of children before the civil war" . This phrase has been picked up by several media outlets and is part of the portrait that Gibney constructed of Musk .'

St. Clair’s testimony adds a personal dimension to the documentary and raises one of the film’s central questions: to what extent can Musk ’s power and wealth influence those who decide to speak publicly about him.

These claims correspond to St. Clair's testimony and have not been publicly corroborated by Musk, who chose not to participate in the documentary. The businessman has criticized the film and called it a “hit piece” .

Musk had its world premiere on September 8 at the Venice Film Festival and will arrive in U.S. theaters on October 16, 2026 , distributed by Bleecker Street.

articles.title: Elon Musk: "I take the position that I'm always to some degree wrong, and the aspiration is to be less wrong"
articles.standfirst: Elon Musk has built a career around ambitious bets, but one of his most revealing comments is surprisingly simple: accept that you are wrong and keep working to improve
articles.summary: Elon Musk has built a career around ambitious bets, but one of his most revealing comments is surprisingly simple: accept that you are wrong and keep working to improve
articles.body:
E lon Musk has never been short of confidence. From electric vehicles and reusable rockets to artificial intelligence and social media, the billionaire entrepreneur has repeatedly pursued projects that once appeared unrealistic to many observers.

Yet one of Musk's most frequently cited comments offers a different perspective on how he approaches difficult decisions.

“I take the position that I'm always to some degree wrong, and the aspiration is to be less wrong.”

The quote, listed among Musk's most popular statements on Goodreads, captures a philosophy that he has discussed in interviews over the years.

Rather than treating being right as the objective, Musk has argued that entrepreneurs should constantly challenge their assumptions and use new information to move closer to the truth.

That idea is particularly relevant given the scale of the companies Musk has built and led. He has been a central figure at Tesla, SpaceX and X while also building his artificial-intelligence business, xAI.

Forbes currently lists him as the world's wealthiest person, with his fortune boosted significantly by SpaceX's 2026 public offering.

Musk's approach is closely connected to his interest in physics and first-principles thinking. Instead of starting with conventional assumptions, he has often argued that complicated problems should be broken down into fundamental truths before solutions are developed.

In one interview, Musk explained that constantly trying to become "less wrong" was a way of testing ideas against reality.

He acknowledged that the approach could be uncomfortable because it requires people to put their egos aside, but argued that it was useful when searching for the truth.

Why being "less wrong" became central to Musk's philosophy

The concept also helps explain the trial-and-error nature of Musk's business career.

SpaceX experienced multiple failed Falcon 1 launches before eventually reaching orbit, while Tesla spent years facing doubts about whether electric vehicles could become a mass-market business.

Musk has repeatedly embraced the idea that ambitious projects require repeated attempts and adjustments rather than an expectation of getting everything right immediately.

In a 2016 interview with the BBC, Musk said he initially believed Tesla and SpaceX had only about a 10% chance of succeeding. He described himself as someone who is "always to some degree wrong" and said the objective was to become less wrong over time.

That mindset does not mean Musk believes every idea deserves to survive criticism. In fact, his comments about feedback suggest almost the opposite.

He has previously argued that entrepreneurs should actively seek criticism, particularly from people willing to point out mistakes rather than simply reinforce existing beliefs.

The philosophy becomes especially interesting when viewed against Musk's current position.

His companies now operate in industries with enormous consequences. SpaceX has become a major force in the commercial space industry, Tesla remains one of the world's best-known electric-vehicle manufacturers, and xAI has placed Musk directly in the rapidly developing artificial-intelligence race.

Forbes reported that SpaceX became publicly traded in 2026 at a valuation approaching $2 trillion, while Musk retained a major stake.

At the same time, Musk's public profile has become increasingly controversial. A new documentary by filmmaker Alex Gibney premiered at the Venice Film Festival in September 2026 and examines Musk's business empire, political influence and public persona. Musk declined to participate and has criticized the project.

That contrast makes his "less wrong" philosophy particularly noteworthy. Musk's public image often centers on certainty, bold predictions and aggressive deadlines. But the quote itself argues for something more cautious: recognize that your assumptions can fail, learn from the evidence and adjust.

It is a philosophy that applies far beyond entrepreneurship.

In business, being "less wrong" can mean changing a strategy after customers reject it. In engineering, it can mean modifying a design after a test fails.

In investing, it can mean abandoning an assumption when the data changes. And in everyday life, it can mean being willing to admit that another person has information you overlooked.

Musk has certainly made predictions and decisions that have generated controversy, and acknowledging that no individual is consistently correct does not automatically validate every choice he has made.

articles.title: Pamela Anderson, actress and model: "It's great to be a blonde. With low expectations, it's very easy to surprise people"
articles.standfirst: Pamela Anderson has spent decades challenging assumptions about her image
articles.summary: Pamela Anderson has spent decades challenging assumptions about her image
articles.body:
P amela Anderson has been famous for so long that it can be easy to forget just how dramatically her career has evolved.

The actress and model first became a global star through Baywatch, where her blonde hair and instantly recognizable screen presence became part of the show's visual identity.

But Anderson's career has continued through acting, activism, writing, fashion and, more recently, a critically acclaimed return to serious film work.

One of her most memorable observations about the way the public perceived her remains remarkably concise.

"It's great to be a blonde. With low expectations it's very easy to surprise people."

The quote is attributed to Anderson by several quotation sources, including What Should I Read Next? and BrainyQuote.

At first glance, the line sounds like a joke about the stereotypes attached to blonde women. But it also reflects something that has followed Anderson throughout her career: the gap between the public image created around her and the person she has repeatedly shown herself to be.

Anderson became one of the defining celebrity figures of the 1990s after joining Baywatch. Her appearance, glamour and Playboy modeling career made her a fixture of popular culture, but she also developed interests that extended well beyond entertainment.

She became a prominent animal-rights campaigner and has worked with PETA for decades. She has also written books, produced documentaries and spoken publicly about environmental issues and personal experiences.

That willingness to use her celebrity for causes she believed in helped complicate the simplistic image attached to her early career.

Anderson has spent the last few years rewriting the Pamela Anderson story

Her recent career has arguably provided the strongest evidence that she was never interested in remaining confined to the expectations created around her.

In 2023, Anderson appeared at Paris Fashion Week without makeup, a decision that generated widespread attention and became part of a broader shift in how she presented herself publicly.

Rather than relying on the highly constructed glamour associated with her earlier career, Anderson increasingly embraced a more natural aesthetic.

Her biggest professional reinvention came with The Last Showgirl, in which she played Shelly Gardner , a veteran Las Vegas performer confronting the end of her longtime show. The role represented a major dramatic opportunity and earned Anderson a Golden Globe nomination.

The film also helped change the conversation surrounding her acting career. Instead of being discussed primarily through the lens of Baywatch or celebrity culture, Anderson was being recognized for her dramatic performance and willingness to take on more demanding material.

That evolution has continued into 2026. Anderson has remained active in film and fashion while developing projects including Rosebush Pruning, Love is Not the Answer, Queen of the Falls, Somedays and Place to Be.

She has also maintained a connection to beauty through Sonsie, her skincare brand, while continuing to use her platform for causes beyond entertainment. Her official website currently highlights The Last Showgirl, The Naked Gun, Sonsie and her writing projects among her work.

Anderson's appearance at the 2026 Venice Film Festival offered another reminder of how far her public image has traveled.

At an amfAR gala, she was honored with the Award of Courage and spoke emotionally about overcoming hepatitis C, a diagnosis she received in 2002 and for which she later received successful treatment.

Her recent work therefore gives the old blonde joke a different meaning.

The point is not simply that people underestimated her. It is that Anderson learned how to use the assumptions surrounding her as part of her public persona while continuing to pursue interests that went far beyond those assumptions.

That may be why the quote has endured. Its humor is deliberately self-aware, but there is also an element of strategy behind it.

"It's great to be a blonde. With low expectations it's very easy to surprise people,” Anderson once said.

For someone whose career has repeatedly involved surprising the public, Anderson's line now feels less like a throwaway joke and more like an explanation of how she learned to navigate fame.

From Baywatch to dramatic film roles, from modeling to activism and from highly styled celebrity to a more stripped-back public identity, Anderson has spent decades proving that first impressions rarely tell the whole story.

articles.title: Who is Zenwilliam Robson? The man arrested for stalking Kris Jenner near her home
articles.standfirst: Zenwilliam Robson, 25, was detained by security near Kris Jenner’s Los Angeles-area residence
articles.summary: Zenwilliam Robson, 25, was detained by security near Kris Jenner’s Los Angeles-area residence
articles.body:
K ris Jenner is facing another security scare after a 25-year-old man was arrested near her home in the Santa Monica Mountains on suspicion of stalking.

The man has been identified as Zenwilliam Robson , who was reportedly detained by a security guard on Monday evening before he could reach Jenner’s residence.

According to NBC Los Angeles, security personnel told authorities that Robson had attempted to contact the 70-year-old “Keeping Up with the Kardashians” star on multiple occasions in the past.

The incident reportedly unfolded near Jenner’s Los Angeles-area property, which sits in the Santa Monica Mountains northwest of the city. TMZ similarly reported that Jenner’s private security team stopped Robson before he was able to get anywhere near the house.

Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department deputies subsequently arrested Robson on suspicion of stalking. However, NBC Los Angeles reported that the formal charge filed against him was one misdemeanor count of trespassing and refusing to leave private property.

That distinction is important because an arrest or accusation does not establish guilt. The available reports do not indicate that Robson has been convicted of stalking or trespassing.

It was also not immediately clear whether Jenner herself was at home when the incident happened. Her representatives had not publicly commented on the arrest at the time of the reports. NBC Los Angeles said a court appearance for Robson was scheduled for Wednesday.

Who is Zenwilliam Robson and what happened?

Beyond his age and his identification in connection with the arrest, relatively little verified information about Robson's background has been made public.

The reports currently focus on the circumstances surrounding his detention rather than providing details about his occupation, personal life or relationship to Jenner .

According to authorities cited by NBC Los Angeles, security personnel had previously been concerned about attempts to contact the television personality.

The security response also meant that Robson was stopped before he reached Jenner’s residence itself. TMZ reported that the security team detained him in the area before he could get to the property, after which law enforcement became involved.

The incident comes against a backdrop of repeated security concerns involving members of the Kardashian-Jenner family.

Kim Kardashian has sought restraining orders against alleged stalkers on multiple occasions. In a 2025 preview for the seventh season of “The Kardashians,” she also claimed that “Someone extremely close to me put a hit out on my life.” The identity of the person referenced was not disclosed.

articles.title: Céline Dion regains the spotlight in Paris and once again opts for looks that don't go unnoticed
articles.standfirst: The Canadian singer is preparing her return to the stage while adding new public appearances in the French capital. Her wardrobe, defined by black, structured silhouettes, and a carefully chosen selection of accessories, also occupies a prominent place in this new chapter.
articles.summary: The Canadian singer is preparing her return to the stage while adding new public appearances in the French capital. Her wardrobe, defined by black, structured silhouettes, and a carefully chosen selection of accessories, also occupies a prominent place in this new chapter.
articles.body:
"C éline Dion is already in Paris to prepare for her return to the stage, and her appearances in the French capital are once again sparking interest also because of her wardrobe choices. The 58-year-old Canadian singer was photographed on September 9 as she left the Royal Monceau hotel heading to rehearsals for her upcoming concert accompanied by her children.

The appearance comes in the final stretch of her return to the stage, with her three children, René-Charles Angélil and twins Nelson and Eddy , accompanying her during her stay in the French capital. Dion, 58, is putting the finishing touches on her new musical era, and her outfits are once again taking center stage in her public appearances.

The evolution of Céline Dion's style and her presence in Paris

Fashion has accompanied much of Dion's public trajectory. From black dresses with defined lines to leather garments and more understated proposals, the artist has built an easily recognizable image beyond the stage as well.

One example appears in one of the posts that Dion herself shared on Instagram. In the images, she poses in a long black dress paired with a structured-cut jacket. The outfit opts for a clean silhouette and plays with different textures and volumes.

The singer has also worn leather garments and more distinctly inspired designs. In another of her posts, she appears wearing a black coat with a glossy finish, paired with stockings and high-heeled shoes. It is a different look, but it maintains a characteristic that is common in her choices: black as the basis for outfits that seek a defined image.

Her relationship with fashion is nothing new. Dion starred in some of her most talked-about appearances in Paris during the years when she began working with stylists and haute couture designers. The French city then became one of the regular settings for her public appearances and her wardrobe choices.

Now, Paris once again plays a central role in her schedule. The singer was seen arriving at rehearsals wearing a dark gray midi dress with structured shoulders, long brown leather gloves, and tall boots in the same shade. She completed the outfit with dark sunglasses and a black handbag.

The moment comes as the artist prepares her return to the stage after the health problems that led her to cancel part of her professional activity. Dion announced in 2022 that she had stiff-person syndrome and subsequently scaled back her performances . In 2024, she reappeared at a major international event by performing Hymne à l"amour during the opening ceremony of the Paris Olympic Games.

Her upcoming concerts place her back in Paris and explain the attention surrounding her latest appearances. This time, in addition to rehearsals and her musical return, her outfits are working as another of the elements accompanying the singer's return to public life.

articles.title: Bianca Censori draws Kim Kardashian comparisons after posing in tiny gold bikini
articles.standfirst: The striking resemblance revived an old question about how much Kanye West influences his wife’s provocative style
articles.summary: The striking resemblance revived an old question about how much Kanye West influences his wife’s provocative style
articles.body:
B ianca Censori has again found herself being compared with Kim Kardashian after revealing a dramatic blonde transformation and posing in a tiny metallic gold bikini. The 31-year-old completed the look with a matching chainmail-style skirt, long blonde hair, heavy eye makeup and pale lips.

The resemblance was difficult to ignore. Kardashian adopted a remarkably similar aesthetic for SKIMS’ Metallic Swim campaign in 2022, wearing gold and silver bikinis with voluminous platinum-blonde hair and glamorous retro makeup.

Was Censori directly inspired by Kardashian? Did Kanye West help shape a look that recalls his former wife, or do both women simply share a taste for daring fashion that celebrates their bodies? The images naturally invite every theory, but there is no evidence proving that Censori deliberately copied Kardashian or that Ye asked her to do so.

Bianca Censori has answered questions about Kanye West’s influence

The speculation is especially sensitive because Censori has repeatedly been portrayed as being controlled by her husband. However, she rejected that idea in a 2026 interview, explaining that she and West develop her outfits together as a creative collaboration. “I wouldn’t be doing something I didn’t want to do,” she said while defending her autonomy and describing her life and appearance as part of her art.

Bianca is also an architectural designer who has worked with Yeezy, making fashion part of her professional world rather than simply something imposed upon her. People reported her full comments.

The connection between the two women remains obvious. Kardashian and West married in 2014, finalized their divorce in 2022 and share four children: North, Saint, Chicago and Psalm. Censori married West later that year and has since been photographed spending time with his children, including separate outings with North and Chicago.

Neither Kardashian nor Censori has publicly turned the comparisons into a personal confrontation . Kardashian has not publicly reacted to the new gold-bikini photographs, while Censori has never confirmed that Kim serves as her fashion inspiration. The two were even seen standing together at one of West’s Vultures listening events in 2024, suggesting that their connection is more complicated and possibly less hostile than the online narrative implies.

Kardashian, meanwhile, appears focused on her own family, businesses and relationship with Formula One driver Lewis Hamilton. Her connection with West now centers largely on raising their children. Just days before Censori’s photographs appeared, both parents attended North’s first solo headlining concert in Chicago, supporting their daughter from different areas of the venue. People documented the family moment.

West was also in Chicago for his first hometown concert since 2021, performing at Soldier Field with guests including Big Sean, Future, 2 Chainz and Twista. Against that backdrop, Censori’s new look may be artistic expression, shared creative direction with her husband or simply a style she knows looks powerful on her.
